main_text.p: data, vellet: atque in hunc usum ad-huc hodie verba illa institutionis, quo-ties cœna Domini in Ecclesia cele-bratur, recitantur, ut accessuri ad mē-sam Dominicam, intelligant ad quid panem & vinum, ex Christi mandato & præscripto, sumant.

Iactantur magnifica de syllabis & apicibus viuentis Dei, quæ nobis cœ-lo ac terra firmiora esse debeant. Sanè si perpetuæ voluntati Dei, rerumque significatarum constantissimę verita-ti seruiant, non repugnent. An quæso rei in cœna à Christo sancitæ natura, minus apud nos, quàm nuda verborum auctoritas, valeat? Horumne syllabis & apicibus ad sacramenti incolumi-tatem & stabilitatem, an ad eius perniciem potius utamur? Mihi quidem certè maiori Deum iniuria afficere videtur is qui Christi verba in rei ab ipso institutæ euersionem detorquet, quàm qui, ut res saluas obtineat, verba Christi quomodocunque eò accommodat. Christũ suis in sacra cœ-

page.notes: The word "verita-ti" contains a Cyrillic-looking letter in the transcription above; the printed word is "veritati" (line-end hyphen after "verita-"). Catchword "na" is printed at the right below the last line. The right edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page and is excluded. "Christũ" carries a tilde as printed. The text "ut" and "usum" are spelled with u/v correction as instructed; "constantissimę" keeps the printed ę.
